additional_info.subject: ID0443403-DC/Si-D/SA-[Multiple] Charger Screen Failure 180 kw EVCS CRM:02681000619
additional_info.body:
Hello Mohannad, good afternoon. I hope all is well with you.
Remotely, we are not able to check it unfortunately.
If the screen is fully black please try these:
Removing and reinserting the DisplayPort cable
Replacing the Display Port cable, if the above didn't work
Do these measurements, this is a guide that I created myself:
For this Display controller:
The screen appeared to have a backlight and as such I recommended to update the Display driver because as stated, the DP cable was already the new one.
After following the guide, when we got to the FW update, we could see that the LEDs on top were not light up, even though there were 24.6 V being applied to the controller and the firmware could not recognize the controller:
Initially I believed that it might be a voltage drop from the power supply to the controller and as such we disconnected the cable from pin 4c of F11-XD21 and reconnect it.
After this the voltage was 24.78 V and in the display terminal was 24.73 V:
We measured both sides of the connector to make sure it is not the connector that is faulty and concluded that the connector is not faulty.
Do you know if these HMI's have been updated previously? If not, I send the instructions on how to do it in attach and the software. If the update doesn't work as in the instructions and we have ~25V in the connector, then we need to replace the HMI.
I recommend you to take spare HMIs to site in case it needs replacement. Make sure to order the new RAFI displays. I will send this ticket to the RC-SA queue.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
